title: API returns empty responses
description: All API endpoints return empty responses causing 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' JSON parse errors. Users cannot get any stock analysis data.
suggested_fix: Check Vercel deployment and ensure analyze.js function exports handler correctly with proper return statements

title: CORS headers missing
description: GitHub Pages frontend cannot access Vercel API due to missing CORS headers. Users see network errors when trying to analyze stocks.
suggested_fix: Add 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' and handle OPTIONS preflight requests in analyze.js

title: Multiple theme toggle buttons conflict
description: Three buttons share .theme-toggle class causing Playwright strict mode violations. Theme toggle functionality may be broken.
suggested_fix: Use unique IDs or classes: .home-btn, .account-btn, .theme-btn instead of shared .theme-toggle class

title: Add stock button not clickable
description: Landing page elements intercept clicks on Add Stock button. Users cannot add stocks to their portfolio.
suggested_fix: Fix z-index stacking or pointer-events CSS on .lp-stat elements to not block .add-btn clicks

title: Stock chart not rendering
description: Price charts don't appear after selecting stocks. Users cannot visualize stock price movements and technical analysis.
suggested_fix: Ensure chart library is loaded and chart container is populated with API data in displayAnalysis function

title: RSI calculation returns zero
description: RSI indicator calculation is incorrect, returning 0 instead of ~50 for flat prices. Technical analysis will be misleading.
suggested_fix: Fix RSI calculation in calcRSI function to handle edge cases and return proper 0-100 values

title: Missing input validation
description: API doesn't validate required parameters or return proper 400 errors. Invalid requests return 404 instead of meaningful errors.
suggested_fix: Add parameter validation at start of analyze.js handler and return 400 status for missing/invalid symbols

title: localStorage cache not working
description: Stock analysis results aren't cached locally. Users experience slower performance on repeated stock lookups.
suggested_fix: Implement caching in fetchAnalysis function to store/retrieve results from localStorage with symbol key

title: Remove stock button missing
description: Users cannot remove stocks from their portfolio as remove buttons don't exist on stock cards.
suggested_fix: Add .remove-btn elements to stock card template in displayAnalysis or createStockCard function
